# Research results

*Generated by `python -m antenatal research-results` on 2026-10-24T07:32:10+00:00 from `outputs/research/results_table.csv`. No model was fitted to produce it.*

## Research questions

| Number | Question | Endpoint | Method | Null hypothesis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Do first visit values add predictive value beyond the second visit (set C over set B)? | Average precision, the area under the precision recall curve | Paired group bootstrap of C minus B on pooled out of fold predictions | The difference in average precision is zero |
| 2 | Do second visit values add discrimination beyond registration (set B over set A)? | ROC AUC, the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve | Paired group bootstrap of B minus A; DeLong's test as descriptive | The difference in ROC AUC is zero |
| 3 | What share of low birth weight births falls in the top 10, 20 and 30 percent of the served model's ranking, against ranking at random? | Retrieval at each budget minus the budget itself | Group bootstrap of retrieval minus the random expectation | The served ranking retrieves no more than random |
| 4 | Is missingness informative: do missingness indicators improve sets B and C? | Average precision with indicators minus without | Paired group bootstrap on the same folds | Indicators change average precision by zero |

## Results on development records

Pooled out of fold predictions averaged over 10 repeats, 3,126 records with 165 events. Each interval is a paired group bootstrap with 2,000 resamples; p is twice the smaller share of resamples on either side of zero. Questions 1 and 2 are prespecified and not adjusted; the other tested rows are one exploratory family with a Holm adjustment. DeLong's test ignores registration groups and is descriptive only. No test is made over fold level results.

## Held out records

The single held out evaluation has not been run. It runs once, after the supervisor's approval, by the protocol in `docs/holdout_protocol.md`; this section is then filled from `outputs/tables/holdout_comparisons.csv`.
